verses.text: O God, the nations are come into thine inheritance; Thy holy temple have they defiled; They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

segments.text: O God, the nations are come into thine inheritance;
Thy holy temple have they defiled;
They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

verses.text: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be food unto the birds of the heavens, The flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

segments.text: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be food unto the birds of the heavens,
The flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

verses.text: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; And there was none to bury them.

segments.text: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem;
And there was none to bury them.

verses.text: We are become a reproach to our neighbors, A scoffing and derision to them that are round about us.

segments.text: We are become a reproach to our neighbors,
A scoffing and derision to them that are round about us.

verses.text: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou be angry for ever? Shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

segments.text: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou be angry for ever?
Shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

verses.text: Pour out thy wrath upon the nations that know thee not, And upon the kingdoms that call not upon thy name.

segments.text: Pour out thy wrath upon the nations that know thee not,
And upon the kingdoms that call not upon thy name.

verses.text: For they have devoured Jacob, And laid waste his habitation.

segments.text: For they have devoured Jacob,
And laid waste his habitation.

verses.text: Remember not against us the iniquities of our forefathers: Let thy tender mercies speedily meet us; For we are brought very low.

segments.text: Remember not against us the iniquities of our forefathers:
Let thy tender mercies speedily meet us;
For we are brought very low.

verses.text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name; And deliver us, and forgive our sins, for thy name’s sake.

segments.text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name;
And deliver us, and forgive our sins, for thy name’s sake.

verses.text: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is their God? Let the avenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed Be known among the nations in our sight.

segments.text: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is their God?
Let the avenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed
Be known among the nations in our sight.

verses.text: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee: According to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to death;

segments.text: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee:
According to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to death;

verses.text: And render unto our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

segments.text: And render unto our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom
Their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

verses.text: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture Will give thee thanks for ever: We will show forth thy praise to all generations.

segments.text: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture
Will give thee thanks for ever:
We will show forth thy praise to all generations.
